data.greeting: Hi Northeast families! The big news this week: After School Enrichment registration opens Monday, Sept 14, and PTA members get first pick. Also inside: Film on the Field has a new date, the website has a new Getting to School menu, and a reminder that PTA memberships start fresh every year.

data.when: Opens Monday, Sept 14 · 8:30 AM for PTA members
data.headline: ASE registration opens Monday, Sept 14. PTA members go first.
data.text: Fall After School Enrichment has 12 classes for grades K–5, on Tuesdays and Wednesdays from 3 to 4 PM for 7 weeks. Each class has 10 to 16 spots. 2026–27 PTA members register first, so if you haven't rejoined yet, do it before 8:30 AM on Monday.

data.headline: Can you help on Tuesdays? Your child gets a free class.
data.body: Thank you to everyone who signed up: Wednesdays are fully staffed. We still need volunteers to help supervise ASE on Tuesdays, 2:30 to 4 PM, for 7 weeks starting Sept 22. Volunteers' children can take one ASE class for free.
data.link_text: Email Leslie to volunteer on Tuesdays →

rows.title: ASE registration opens
rows.desc: PTA members 8:30 AM–12:30 PM, then closed until it reopens for everyone at 5 PM.

rows.title: ASE registration closes at noon
rows.desc: Last chance to sign up for fall classes.

rows.title: ASE classes begin
rows.desc: Tuesday classes start Sept 22, Wednesday classes Sept 23. Pick-up is at 4 PM in front of the school.

rows.title: Last day to order mums
rows.desc: Pre-orders close. Proceeds support the 5th grade class. Order at mums26.givesmart.com.

rows.title: Fifth Grade Car Wash + mum pickup
rows.desc: 9 AM–12 PM in front of Northeast. Get your car washed by the 5th graders and pick up your mums while you're there.

rows.title: Back-to-School Night · 6–7 PM
rows.desc: Meet your child's teacher and see the classroom.

rows.title: Film on the Field · new date
rows.desc: Moved from Oct 2. Rain date Friday, Oct 23. Time to be announced.

cards.heading: Film on the Field moves to Friday, October 16.
cards.body: Our fall movie night on the Northeast field is now Friday, October 16, two weeks later than the Oct 2 date in last week's newsletter. If it rains, the rain date is Friday, October 23. Time to be announced; bring blankets and chairs. We'll post the time on the PTA calendar once it's set.

cards.heading: Drop-off help, all in one place: Getting to School.
cards.body: The website menu has a new Getting to School section with two pages for your morning and afternoon trips: a live traffic page that tells you whether to leave earlier, and the morning car line, stop by stop.

cards.heading: Were you a member last year? Please sign up again.
cards.body: PTA memberships reset every school year, so last year's membership doesn't carry over. Joining for 2026–27 takes about two minutes, and individual membership is $20.

items.heading: Lunch menu
items.body: This week's breakfast and lunch menus are always on the site, one day at a time on mobile.

items.heading: Subscribe to the calendar
items.body: Add the Northeast calendar to your phone once and it updates itself whenever a date changes. No more screenshots.

items.heading: Family Handbook
items.body: Arrival, dismissal, early pickup, absences: the 2026–2027 handbook is on the site and searchable.

data.signoff:
Good luck with ASE sign-ups this week, and thank you to the volunteers who make those classes happen. Thanks for reading, and for being part of this community.

Warmly,
Your Northeast PTA Board
